cultural.vision_reason: The image shows two thatched-roof granary structures with grave markers in a compound courtyard, matching the museum's own description of a Nigerian (Gwari/Gbagyi-region) homestead; this is documentary architecture consistent with the claimed people's homeland.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, inside a Gwarl compound. Two "graves" in foreground, marked by stone surrounded by circular pattern of small white [?] objects. Two circular, thatched-roof buildings [granaries?] at rear.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
